title: Scattered Environment-Detection Factories
pattern: Checking environmental profiles (e.g., `test`, `prod`) inside various constructors and low-level code factories scattered across the codebase.
why_bad: Couples the application internals to environment naming schemas and config keys. Introducing a new environment or changing a config variable name requires modifying and recompiling multiple files.
detection: Arbitrary environment checks (`env::var`) or conditional testing factories placed within low-level utility or core modules rather than isolated at startup boundaries.
fix: Centralize configuration parsing inside a single bootstrap layer at startup, resolving parameters into concrete configurations or plugin structures before initialization.
source: [The Addison-Wesley signature series] Martin Fowler - *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2015_2002, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Chapter 18.
